jobs.description:
Your role
For one of our most prestigious clients in Brussels, we are looking for an Office & Reception Collaborator to take on a key hospitality and coordination role within the site.

You will work in an international and highly professional environment, welcoming and supporting a community that includes diplomatic members and high-level visitors.

This position goes beyond traditional reception duties. You will become a central point of contact for the floor, ensuring that daily operations run smoothly, events are properly coordinated and every visitor and member receives a consistently high level of hospitality.

The position represents 37 hours of work per week.
Your mission
Your first objective will be to develop an excellent understanding of the entire floor, its organisation, its community and its operating protocols.

As the position involves regular interaction with diplomatic members and visitors, professionalism, discretion and respect for established protocols are essential.

Together with your colleague on the floor, you will ensure the smooth coordination of daily activities and maintain a welcoming, organised and professional environment.
Your main responsibilities
• Welcome members, visitors and guests in a warm and professional manner
• Learn and follow the specific protocols and procedures applicable to the floor
• Coordinate and organise events, meetings and activities taking place on the floor
• Prepare and monitor meeting rooms and shared spaces
• Ensure that coffee machines and hospitality areas are operational, clean and properly supplied
• Coordinate daily operational and hospitality requirements
• Work closely with your floor colleague to ensure continuity and an effective distribution of responsibilities
• Anticipate needs and respond proactively to requests from members and visitors
• Coordinate with internal teams, suppliers and relevant service providers when required
• Follow up on existing community services, including access-related services, dry cleaning and other concierge services
• Support administrative tasks and maintain clear operational follow-up
• Contribute actively to creating a genuine sense of hospitality and community throughout the floorWorking schedule
This is a 37-hour-per-week position.

A standard working schedule will be established. However, flexibility is an important part of the role, as working hours may occasionally be adapted according to the client's needs, scheduled events and the level of activity on the floor.

We are therefore looking for someone who is comfortable working within a structured schedule while remaining flexible when operational needs require it.
 Your profile
For this position, we are looking for someone who combines excellent hospitality skills with strong organisational abilities.

You:

• Have a strong sense of hospitality and genuinely enjoy working with people
• Are highly organised, structured and able to manage several priorities
• Have good working knowledge of Microsoft Office
• Communicate professionally and confidently with different types of guests and stakeholders
• Understand the importance of discretion, confidentiality and professional conduct
• Are comfortable working in an international and diplomatic environment
• Are proactive and capable of identifying what needs to be done without always waiting for instructions
• Enjoy working as part of a two-person team while also being capable of working independently
• Are physically comfortable moving regularly throughout the floor during the working day
• Are flexible regarding working hours when events or operational requirements require adjustments
• Are eligible to meet the client's applicable security and background requirements
• Are available to start as soon as possibleLanguages
As you will be working in an international environment, strong language skills are essential:

• English is mandatory
• Fluency in at least one of Belgium's national languages - French, Dutch or German - is mandatory
• Knowledge of additional languages is highly appreciated and considered an asset
Previous experience in corporate reception, hospitality, front office, office support, events or workplace services is a strong asset.
 What we offer
We offer a fixed-term contract (CDD) of 37 hours per week, with the perspective of developing into a permanent contract (CDI).

You will join one of our most prestigious client environments and take on a position with real responsibility and visibility within the site.

You can also expect:

• A professional and international working environment
• A key role combining reception, office support, hospitality and event coordination
• A high level of autonomy and responsibility
• Close collaboration with another colleague on the floor
• The opportunity to build strong relationships with an international community
• A position where your ideas, initiative and organisational skills can make a real difference
• Salary and benefits in accordance with the applicable Belgian employment conditionsMore than a reception role
This position is ultimately about creating an experience.

Beyond supporting meetings, events and daily operations, your role is to make people feel welcome, supported and part of a community.

You will be one of the key people responsible for bringing hospitality, organisation and a human touch to the floor every day.
Ready to Join Ask Nestor?
If you are passionate about facilities, hospitality, and operational excellence, and you enjoy creating exceptional workplace experiences, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of the Ask Nestor team.

As a Senior Data Architect, you will be responsible for defining and implementing the enterprise-wide data architecture that supports critical business initiatives and drives data-driven decision-making. You'll shape the structure, governance, and strategic roadmap of data assets across the organization¿ensuring data is accessible, secure, integrated, and aligned with evolving business needs.

You'll collaborate with senior stakeholders in IT, analytics, and the business to architect scalable data solutions across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments¿balancing innovation with long-term sustainability.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and evolve enterprise data architecture, aligning with business strategies and regulatory requirements.
• Lead data modelling efforts across operational and analytical domains (OLTP/OLAP), including conceptual, logical, and physical models.
• Promote a hands-on, pragmatic approach towards data architecture and the overall team dynamic
• Define and implement data standards, policies, and governance frameworks.
• Guide the architecture of data platforms, support self-service, AI, Dashboarding and real-time streaming solutions.
• Partner with Data Engineers, Analysts, Architects, and Business stakeholders to ensure data quality, accessibility, and lineage.
• Influence senior stakeholders and business owners across the organisation (38K, global)
• Evaluate and recommend technologies and tools for data integration, storage, cataloguing, and analytics.
• Ensure data architecture enables AI/ML, advanced analytics, and reporting initiatives.
• Support compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, or other regulatory standards depending on the region/industry.
• Provide architectural oversight and leadership across data-related projects and programs.
• Mentor junior data architects and engineers, contributing to a strong data architecture community. 
We do not only deliver letters and parcels, but also opportunities. This job is open to all with diverse backgrounds and talents, possessing the following profile:  
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.
• 8+ years of experience in large scale data architecture or related fields (over 100m events); 3+ years in a senior or enterprise role.
• Strong hands-on expertise in data architecture design for cloud (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid environments.
• Deep knowledge of data modelling techniques, ETL/ELT pipelines, automation (CICD scripting, Airflow...) and data lifecycle management.
• Experience with streaming data is a strong asset (Kafka, Flink...). Experience with Semantic integration and Ontology also assets.
• Familiarity with modern data stacks: Snowflake, Databricks, DBT, etc.
• Understanding of data security, master data management (MDM), data mesh, and metadata management.
• Excellent communication (business fluent English, French and/or Dutch are a plus) and leadership skills with the ability to translate complex data topics for business audiences.
• Experience working in Agile or DevOps environments is a plus.
• 2 days per week (minimum) hybrid office presence. 
Like a long-awaited parcel, we want to make you feel welcome and valued. Our offer includes:  

·       Competitive monthly salary 

·       Meal vouchers 

·       Hospitalization-, group- and disability insurances 

·       A phone subscription and company car 

·       20 days of statutory leave and 7 additional extralegal days off  

·       An end-of-year and performance-based bonus and double holiday pay  

·       Many benefits from more than 100 bpost-partners 

 

Why bpostgroup? 

bpostgroup is Belgium's leading postal operator and a growing parcel & omni-commerce logistics partner globally. With a focus on social and environmental sustainability, we aim to be a trusted guide in a changing world. As our newest team member you will:  

·       Become part of the bpostgroup family with a unique atmosphere and culture. 

·       Enjoy a dynamic work environment with a hybrid model allowing for flexibility. 

·       Have access to continuous learning and development opportunities. 

·       Have a direct impact on decision-making in an international success story. 

·       Thrive in a leadership culture centered on visioning, sense making, innovation, and relating, empowering you to lead effectively in our forward-thinking organization.  

Find out more about bpostgroup   

#LI-DNI 

No match?  

Explore other exciting job opportunities with us.

For a international client in Data information with it's headquarters in Gent are we looking for a Team Lead.

We are seeking an experienced Team Lead Java to join the team and drive the development of cutting-edge software solutions that support logistics, supply chain, and identification services. This role provides an opportunity to contribute to a company at the forefront of technology, delivering impactful solutions for clients worldwide.
Role
In this role, you will lead a team of skilled Java developers, overseeing architecture design, ensuring code quality, and guiding team members to achieve their full potential. You’ll be responsible for managing the end-to-end development cycle, collaborating closely with other departments to deliver high-quality applications. This position is ideal for someone with strong Java expertise, leadership experience, and a passion for innovation.

You possess:

You will work in Ninove, in a modern and highly automated environment specialized in logistics automation and automated warehouse systems.

The company develops, integrates and maintains automation solutions that help warehouses, production environments and distribution centers operate more efficiently.

Jobomschrijving

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.

Your responsibilities:
	
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.	
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.	
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.	
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.	
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.	
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.	
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).	
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.	
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations.

	
• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.	
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.	
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.	
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.	
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.	
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.	
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.	
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.	
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.	
• Good physical fitness.	
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.	
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

Industry- automation systems warehouse

Jobomschrijving

For a company that designs, integrates, and maintains logistics automation solutions to optimize internal logistics processes in warehouses, production, and distribution

Your Responsibilities:
	
• Maintenance, repair, and installation of complex warehouse automation systems.	
• Ensure smooth operation of our installations by performing timely maintenance and resolving technical issues quickly and efficiently.	
• Analyze malfunctions and resolve them independently, with an eye for safety and customer satisfaction.	
• Work mostly independently, but be a team player when necessary.	
• Report your interventions in our system to ensure and improve quality.

	
• Diploma in electromechanics, electricity, and/or mechanics.	
• Basic knowledge of automation is a plus, such as knowledge of SCADA, use of multimeters.	
• Several years of experience in a technical role is a plus.	
• Work independently, accurately, and customer-oriented.	
• Fluent communication in Dutch and/or English.	
• No fear of heights; our work takes place at different levels.	
• Good physical condition for physical work.	
• Flexible and willing to work occasionally outside standard hours.	
• Motivated, responsible, and keep administration tidy.	
• Eager to learn and share a passion for technology.	
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, PLC control systems; if this appeals to you, this job is for you.	
• All-round PC skills and experience with CMMS systems, (Sprocket).	
• “You are open to working weekends.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.

Your key responsibilities:
	
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.	
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.	
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.	
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.	
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:
	
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.	
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 	
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.	
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.	
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.	
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.	
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 
	
• Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, …) in a controlled temperature environment.	
• Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies. 	
• Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic

• You are a problem solver and have strong analytical and data skills.	
• You follow the procedures strictly to ensure both product quality and personal health & safety are followed at all times. 	
• Ability to work independently and successfully.

Our client is an international maritime organization based in Essen.

Jobomschrijving

Unique Antwerp Maritime is looking for a Crew Planner.
You will be working for one of our clients, one of the largest offshore pipeline installation and subsea construction companies, located in Essen.

In this role, you will take full responsibility for crew planning within your assigned disciplines. You ensure everything runs smoothly — from long-term workforce planning to last-minute solutions.

Your responsibilities include:
	
• Creating and managing crew schedules for personnel on board our vessels	
• Acting as the point of contact for superintendents, captains, and shore-based colleagues	
• Collaborating closely with HR, Operations, and the crew members themselves	
• Taking into account experience, certifications, and project requirements	
• Identifying shortages or surpluses in staffing and contributing to solutions	
• Ensuring a fair distribution of experience and opportunities within teams	
• Discussing career growth and development opportunities for crew members together with HR
In short: you maintain oversight in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same.

What matters to us?
Your curiosity, drive, and enjoyment of what you do. It’s a big plus if you also bring:
	
• At least 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar role, such as crew planning or transport planning	
• The ability to stay calm and maintain an overview, even when everything happens at once	
• Clear and friendly communication skills, with a good sense of humor	
• The confidence to make decisions and take responsibility, always with respect and situational awareness	
• Fluency in spoken and written English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus	
• A willingness to travel occasionally, for example to vessels or our office in Delft

A company based in Brussels operating in the financial services

jobs.occupation: Tax specialist - Brussels - International Retail Company
jobs.description:
Our client is an international player and global leader in the retail sector with a strong branding and unique company culture. They are currently expanding and reorganizing their finance team to adapt their strategy to the current market.

Jobomschrijving

As a Tax Specialist your function will be twofold. On one side reporting to the accounting manager for the Belgian HQ as well as to the CFO of the e-commerce marketplace.

Belgian HQ:

• Manage monthly VAT filings (BE, FR & LUX)
• Intrastat and statistical declarations (BE, FR & LUX)
• Managing intercompany netting processes and related tax implications.
• Ensuring compliance with indirect tax, customs, and cross-border transaction requirement
• Ensure accurate corporate tax provisions (ISOC)
• Oversee quarterly VAT calculations
• Management Report (PM)
• Corporate tax calculation, transfer pricing and client listings
• Support Pillar 2 compliance 

E-commerce Marketplace:

• Support tax projects and implement tax controls.
• Ensure compliance with DAC7, Deemed Supplier, and C2C requirements.
• Review and validate invoice flows.
• Support profit split analyses and related tax matters.
• Act as the main tax contact for the marketplace business.
• Coordinate with local tax specialists on international projects.
• Identify tax risks and support process improvements.

The ideal candidate matches the following criteria:

• Master's degree in Finance or Law, specialized in Tax / Fiscal sciences
• Fluent in English and good command of French or Dutch
• Strong expertise in corporate tax and indirect tax (VAT)
• Hands-on with proven ability to execute operational tax tasks
• Critical mindset, ability to analyse future impact of regulations on the business
• Experience in international and cross-border tax environments
• Ability to manage multiple compliance cycles (monthly, quarterly, annual)
• Strong communication skills for stakeholder and cross-country coordination

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly?

As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:30 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Charleroi - Industry sector
Project Finance in Charleroi - Industry sector

jobs.description:
Our client is an energy company.

Jobomschrijving

You will work closely with cross-functional teams including development, engineering, finance, tax, legal and operations, and senior management, while collaborating with external advisors, lenders, investors and counterparties to deliver strategic projects and transactions.

• Buy-side M&A transaction: Together with the Director, leading financial appraisal, due diligence, and structuring of BESS and PV transactions.
• Modelling: Build and stress-test investment models (revenue, degradation, volatility, constraints) and translate outputs into clear investment recommendations and strategic decision making to the Director.
• Negotiation: Together with Senior Legal evaluate, negotiate, and optimize key project contracts (PPA, tolling, EPC, O&M/LTSA) through a risk-return lens to protect capital and increase value.
• Project Financing: Ensure projects meet international project finance bankability requirements and optimize cost of capital through robust structuring - in charge of document negotiation with equity and debt providers.
• Strategy: Contribute to portfolio strategy by assessing future risks and opportunities (e.g., grid connection models, longer duration assets, alternative technologies, new jurisdictions).
• Monitoring: Monitor execution and early operational performance, validating investment assumptions and driving feedback loops into future decisions (ie. monitoring actual portfolio performance against budgets and forecasts, preparing performance reports including key financial and business metrics).
• Invoices & Budget: Oversees (and be responsible for) cost control, invoice tracking, annual budgeting and financial reporting.

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related field.
• 7-10 years of experience in investment banking, other forms of M&A advisory, project finance, valuation, ideally with exposure and/or strong interest for renewable energy and energy transition
• Strong financial modelling skills and an understanding of project and corporate finance
• Excellent analytical and presentation skills
• Ability to manage work under pressure in a collaborative environment
• Commercial, outward looking, and focusing on adding value
• Strong critical thinking and willingness to challenge assumptions constructively across the team (technical, development, commercial)
• Excellent communication, organisational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships across internal and external stakeholders
• Fluency in English. French or Dutch is a plus.

For our client in Meer, we are looking for a maintenance technician.

• As a maintenance technician, you are responsible for repairing technical malfunctions in the production machines.
• The issues can be both electrical and mechanical, but the majority are industrial electrical faults. You are responsible for identifying the malfunction and resolving it.
• In addition, you carry out equipment overhauls.
• You ensure that operators and production staff can continue working at all times.
• Preventive and major maintenance tasks are carried out on Saturdays.
• Furthermore, you make suggestions to optimize the process and proactively prevent malfunctions.

• You hold an A2 diploma in electromechanics or industrial electricity, or equivalent through experience
• You are very proficient in reading electrical diagrams
• You are willing to work in a pig slaughterhouse (you are not required to do any slaughtering yourself, only to maintain the machines)
• You have a good command of Dutch or English
• You are willing to work in a shift system. In addition, you will work on Saturdays and can take a compensatory day off during the week (not on Monday or Friday)
• Knowledge of PLCs and/or I/O configuration (not programming) is a plus
• You are flexible with working hours and can work both independently and in a team
• You are willing to work in varying temperature conditions

Our client is a large organization recognized for its expertise and commitment to excellence.

Jobomschrijving

As a KAM your responsibilities are:

• Manage and develop a portfolio of key accounts

• Identify new business opportunities and work on strategies to expand market presence.
• Negotiate contracts and agreements to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
• Analyze sales data and market trends to inform decision-making and strategy development.
• Prepare and present regular reports on account performance and growth opportunities.

A successful KAM should have:

• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English, with excellent communication skills in all three languages.
• Proven experience in managing key accounts 
• Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• Ability to work independently and take initiative in a fast-paced environment.
• Proficiency in analyzing sales data and market trends.
• Customer-focused attitude with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.

jobs.occupation: Area Sales Manager - B2B - Flemish Brabant
jobs.description:

In Belgium, the company has a strong entrepreneurial spirit, focusing on direct sales of professional products and solutions to end users (B2B construction companies).
 
The organization combines the stability of a large group with the agility of a local entity.

Jobomschrijving

As an Area Sales Manager, your main responsibilities will be to:

• Lead and manage a team of around 10 Account Managers (mix of junior and senior profiles)
• Act as coach, and inspiration source for the team
• Strong focus on coaching in the field 
• Provide continuous feedback and translate strategy into concrete actions
• Focus on Flemish Brabant area
• Drive commercial growth while ensuring profitability and long-term relationships
• Stay close to the business
• Maintain contact with key accounts and step in when needed
